title: QPB heartbeat line
description: One JSON object per line in heartbeat.ndjson. The worker emits via plugins/quality-playbook/skills/quality-playbook/scripts/qpb_heartbeat.py (canonical) or the bin/qpb_heartbeat.py shim. Two forms: progress (oneOf branch 1) and terminal (oneOf branch 2). The harness reads tail and applies state-machine transitions. This file is byte-identical to plugins/quality-playbook-harness/skills/quality-playbook-harness/schemas/heartbeat.schema.json — the cross-skill consistency contract is load-bearing (Council finding C-3 silent drift risk; the Phase 1C test test_harness_schemas.py enforces byte-equality).

ts.description: ISO8601 timestamp. The append-only NDJSON ordering invariant: ts of later lines is >= ts of earlier lines in the same file.

task_id.description: UUID matching the job_manifest task_id. Threaded from worker prompt header (TASK_ID=<uuid>) or env var QPB_TASK_ID.

schema_version.description: Schema-version pin. Currently '1'. Harness warns on mismatch.

phase.description: QPB phase name (e.g. 'Phase 1', 'Phase 2'). Required for progress heartbeats; omitted on terminal.

step.description: Specific step within the phase (e.g. 'explore', 'role_map', 'gate'). Required for progress heartbeats; omitted on terminal.

status.description: Progress: STARTING / IN_PROGRESS / COMPLETED / FAILED. Terminal: COMPLETED / FAILED / ABANDONED (last line of the file).

result_file.description: Path (relative to run-dir) of the terminal result file. Present on the terminal line; absent on progress lines.

summary.description: One-line outcome. Present on the terminal line; absent on progress lines.
